messages.subject: Project Granite — negotiation update
messages.plaintextBody:
Edward,

A short update following our v3 SPA going back to the other side yesterday. We have moved the warranty cap to 50% of consideration (they wanted 25%), held the 24-month claims period, and reinstated the three-year non-compete. The retention stays at £2.05m for 18 months. The one remaining open point of substance is the change-of-control consent from Northborough Dairies, which we are managing as a post-completion undertaking.

We remain on track to complete around 12 December.

Kind regards,

Sarah Whitfield
Partner
Whitfield Carter LLP

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

That all sounds sensible. We're content to settle at a 50% cap to get this done. Please keep pressing on the Northborough consent — I'd rather have it in hand than rely on an undertaking, but I understand if the timetable doesn't allow. Thanks to you and the team.

Edward
